name: Barren Island
source_label: Incredible India (Ministry of Tourism, GoI) — Barren Island; access controlled by Indian Navy + Indian Coast Guard, Dept of Fisheries, Police Marine Force

fields.rescue_contact: Indian Coast Guard: 1554 (sole sea-rescue contact ~140 km NE of Port Blair)

notes: Barren Island = India's only active volcano, ~140 km NE of Port Blair. UNINHABITED — no civilian access permitted. Tourists can only view from boats at safe distance with prior permits from Dept of Fisheries + Police Marine Force + Port Mgmt Board + Indian Coast Guard. NO police station, NO hospital, NO pharmacy, NO infrastructure of any kind on or near the island. Sole emergency contact = Indian Coast Guard 1554 (national sea-rescue). All other fields null per honest-scarcity rule. Volcano is monitored by NIO (National Institute of Oceanography) + Indian Navy.
